branded.why: An American fairground and stadium treat since 1988, and a known way of making ice cream.

about.text: Dippin' Dots are small beads of ice cream, made by flash-freezing an ice cream mix in liquid nitrogen and sold from franchised outlets, stadiums, malls and zoos. The company was founded in 1988 in Paducah, Kentucky.

sources.text: The process, origin and history, from the article.
